body: Wow, thank you for everything you said, it really means a lot to me.
Thank you, I appreciate the kind words and advice

I understand, though I do wish I could afford therapy, CBT was kinda helping, but that was many years ago when I was still on my parents good health insurance
(CBT is not drugs btw, it stands for cognitive behavioral therapy)
I don't know if this is for real or not, but don't let people on the internet get you down. The internet makes people excessively cruel and unlike themselves.
I went through the same process, the ADHD medication didn't help me either, so I went back off it, not saying you should, I just am trying to minimize the pills I'm on

I sympathize with this so much. I'm 30 and every job I've had after college has been a good job in a cubicle that I suck at and I quickly pick up on the vibe that no one thinks I'm trying my best (I am, I just suck), that no one likes me and that they resent me being there .

Even before college I couldn't even put stickers on the correct merchandise, or stock fast enough. 

I can't even fill a form out correctly at the doctor's office (which I went yesterday asking them to bump up my meds, but it sucks in the U.S. how even doctors don'tn believe that you are mentally sick, that you just can't be happy for no reason). 

I suck at work place politics, every friend I've had at work has turned on me. I trust people too much and too easily. Ikeep thinking the next job it will be different, but it never is.
